description: Live status of the lifts and slopes of Ski Arlberg around Stuben: lifts open of total, slopes open of total, each lift with its status, and when the data was fetched. Use it for "are the lifts open" questions. Returns UNAVAILABLE when the live source is not available; then point to the Arlberg live page.

language.description: Language of texts and links: de, nl, en. Default de.

name: get_lift_status

code.description: Error code when ok is false, e.g. VALIDATION, NOT_FOUND, UNAVAILABLE.

message.description: Readable error message when ok is false.

ok.description: true on success; false with code and message on an error.

title: Ski Arlberg lift status
